title: Cyril of Jerusalem on Numbers 1:12
body: “The following note is slightly abridged from the Edition of Alexandrides of Jerusalem. "Previous Editions read ex orous pharan kataskiou daseos.”
author: Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lectures
bodyEs: “La nota siguiente está ligeramente abreviada de la edición de Alexándrides de Jerusalén. "Las ediciones anteriores leen ex orous pharan kataskiou daseos.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 11:4
body: “So that one would not be wrong in calling Moses both a teacher, and a nursing-father, and a conductor (Ex.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “De modo que no se erraría al llamar a Moisés maestro, y padre que cría, y guía (Éx.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 11:12
body: “For, that every man can do this, hear what Paul saith, how he charged even lay people; "Edify," he says, "one another, as also ye do." ( 1 Thess.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Porque, de que todo hombre puede hacer esto, oye lo que dice Pablo, cómo encargó incluso a los laicos: "edificaos los unos á los otros, así como lo hacéis." (1 Tes.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 12:13
body: “When the "intercession" of Moses is spoken of, it is natural to suppose that the reference is to Exod.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans
bodyEs: “Cuando se habla de la "intercesión" de Moisés, es natural suponer que la referencia es a Éxodo.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 13:23
body: “How then is it that we shall not suffer the same things? Let us not commit the same acts, and then shall we not suffer the same punishment.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “¿Cómo, pues, no sufriremos las mismas cosas? No cometamos los mismos actos, y entonces no sufriremos el mismo castigo.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 14:10
body: “When the "intercession" of Moses is spoken of, it is natural to suppose that the reference is to Exod.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Acts and Romans
bodyEs: “Cuando se habla de la "intercesión" de Moisés, es natural suponer que la referencia es a Éxodo.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 16:5
body: “But wherefore do they not now bring against Him the charge which they did before, when they said, "Thou bearest witness of thyself, thy witness is not true?" ( c.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Pero ¿por qué no le presentan ahora la acusación que le hicieron antes, cuando dijeron: "Tú de ti mismo das testimonio: tu testimonio no es verdadero"? (c.”

title: John Chrysostom on Numbers 17:12
body: “Perhaps some are even disgusted and laugh. For this very cause ought we to make our lamentations the more intense, because we are so mad and beside ourselves, that we do not know that we are mad, but laugh at things for which we ought to groan.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Quizá algunos incluso se disgustan y se ríen. Por esta misma causa debemos hacer más intenso nuestro lamento, porque estamos tan locos y fuera de nosotros mismos que no sabemos que estamos locos, sino que nos reímos de cosas por las que deberíamos gemir.”
